name: band seated hip abduction v. 2
description: A seated move pushing the knees outward against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with a band around your thighs above the knees.
Keep your feet flat and planted.
Press your knees apart against the band.
Hold for a second at the widest point.
Bring the knees back together slowly.
